phases.name: Owner
phases.goal: Decisions, accounts and people only the owner can provide.

phases.name: Setup
phases.goal: An empty app that builds, tests and deploys a preview on every pull request.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.goal: Sign-in, 18+ sign-up, roles, app shells, account and consent, with access rules proven by tests.

phases.name: Library
phases.goal: Boxing, S&C and Gym lessons people can browse, search, save and complete, with author, review and publish.

phases.name: Training
phases.goal: Coaches build and share programs; athletes train, log and see progress; coaches see logs and give feedback.

phases.name: Marketplace
phases.goal: Athletes find, compare, hire and pay coaches; coaches earn; reviews are verified.

phases.name: AI guide
phases.goal: Cited, safe answers from published lessons, with a daily limit and a passing eval set.

phases.name: Launch
phases.goal: Public pages, legal, every state, PWA, speed, accessibility, security, QA, then production.

tasks.title: Confirm the stack: Next.js only, Supabase, Razorpay
ac: Owner confirms or changes the choices in section 1 of the engineering plan
Decision recorded in MEMORY.md

tasks.title: Create Supabase (Mumbai), Vercel, Anthropic API and Google OAuth accounts
ac: Keys shared through a password manager or Vercel and GitHub secrets, never in chat or the repo
Google OAuth client has the preview and production callback URLs

tasks.title: Upgrade this PC to Node 22 LTS
ac: node --version prints v22 or later (installed v26.13.0 LTS)

tasks.title: Payment provider account, KYC, business and GST registration
ac: Test-mode keys available before M4-09
Route (split payouts) enabled before M4-12
Live mode stays off until M4-16 passes

tasks.title: Set the platform fee %, refund and cancel terms, and the coach agreement
ac: Fee %, refund window and cancel rule written in MEMORY.md
Coach agreement text ready for M4-02

tasks.title: Sign founding coaches: one boxing, one S&C or gym
ac: Each coach lists the first 20 skills or exercises a beginner needs
Each records at least 5 lessons on YouTube before M6

tasks.title: Legal review of privacy policy and terms (DPDP, marketplace)
ac: Signed-off text available before M6-02

tasks.title: Decide on nutrition (meal plans or calorie targets)
ac: Decision in MEMORY.md; out of v1 unless stated

tasks.title: Answer the missing requirements Q-01 to Q-15
ac: Each question in docs/architecture/risks-and-gaps.md has an answer or accepts the stated default
Answers recorded in MEMORY.md decisions

tasks.title: Review design observations D1 to D6 and the key phone screens
ac: Each item in product-analysis.md section 6 is approved, changed or rejected
No design file is edited without this approval

tasks.title: Owner approves this plan and board
ac: Owner says the plan is approved, or lists changes
Approved decisions saved to MEMORY.md
Owner has read docs/architecture/ (product analysis, architecture, risks and gaps)

tasks.title: Scaffold the monorepo: apps/web (Next.js, TypeScript strict), packages/core, packages/ui, packages/config, Turborepo
ac: npm workspaces and Turborepo; npm run verify runs typecheck, lint, unit tests and build across all workspaces and passes
apps/web serves a page with npm run dev
packages/core has a sample pure function with a Vitest test; apps/web imports it
Lint rule blocks core from importing other workspaces
No secrets in the repo; .env.example lists every variable

tasks.title: Fight Camp design tokens and base components
ac: Tokens match the mockups: Anton + Inter, #111111 / #FFFFFF / #D4F000, pill buttons
Button (ink, light, grey, volt, ghost, small), Tag, Input with label and inline error, Checkbox, Radio card, Tabs, Dialog
Every control has a visible focus ring and a 44 px touch target
Component tests cover each variant; axe finds no serious issue on a dev-only /styleguide page

tasks.title: Local Supabase, migrations folder and pgTAP test harness
ac: supabase start runs locally
npm run test:db runs a sample pgTAP test
Migrations apply from scratch with no errors
Typed database client generated into the app

tasks.title: CI on GitHub Actions
ac: Every pull request runs typecheck, lint, unit, database tests and build
A failing test blocks the merge
Main branch is protected
tasks.note: Branch protection needs GitHub Pro or a public repo (owner decision). Until then, merge only on a green CI run.

tasks.title: Vercel preview deploys and environment variables
ac: Each pull request gets a preview URL
Preview uses a separate Supabase project from production
Production deploy needs the owner's approval

tasks.title: Playwright end-to-end harness with seeded test users
ac: Seed creates one athlete, two coaches, one reviewer, one admin
A sample end-to-end test passes locally and in CI
Tests run at 390 px (phone) and 1440 px (desktop)

tasks.title: Error tracking and product analytics
ac: Tools chosen per Q-12
Server and browser errors reach the tracker with no personal data
Events for sign-up, session logged and hire are recorded, so weekly-return numbers can be measured

tasks.title: Identity schema: profiles, user_roles, consents, audit_log, with RLS
ac: pgTAP: a user reads and edits only their own profile
pgTAP: no user can insert or change a role row; only the admin function can
pgTAP: a user cannot change their own role, even as admin
Every role change writes an audit_log row

tasks.title: Sign in with email link or Google
ac: End-to-end: email link from the local inbox signs the user in
A malformed email shows the inline error from the mockup
Resend is disabled for 60 seconds
Google button starts the OAuth flow (manual check on preview)

tasks.title: Sign-up step 1: name, date of birth with server-side 18+ check, sports
ac: Unit: age rule passes for exactly 18 today, fails for 18 tomorrow, handles 29 February
End-to-end: under 18 shows the block screen and no profile data is stored
Check runs on the server; the browser value is not trusted

tasks.title: Sign-up steps 2 to 4: boxing experience, gym goals, summary
ac: End-to-end: full sign-up saves athlete_prefs
AI use of injury notes and body weight is stored as its own consent row with an explicit yes or no
Body weight and height are optional
Summary shows the saved answers and links back to edit
Preferences are stored per sport category as rows (decision D5), so a new sport needs no schema change

tasks.title: App shells and route guards by role
ac: Guest, athlete, coach and admin headers match the mockups
Phone shows bottom tabs (athlete and coach) and the visitor menu
End-to-end: a guest opening /today goes to sign-in; an athlete opening /coach sees a not-allowed page
The guard runs on the server for every protected route

tasks.title: Admin: people and roles
ac: Only an admin sees the page
Changing a role calls the admin function and writes audit_log
An admin cannot change their own role (blocked in the database)

tasks.title: Coach applications: apply, review, make coach or decline
ac: End-to-end: an applicant submits; the admin makes them a coach; their next page load shows the coach header
Experience is labelled self-reported
The applicant gets an email with the decision
After approval the new coach lands on the first-run screen K-CoachEmpty

tasks.title: Account: profile, consent switches, data download, delete account
ac: Turning a consent off takes effect at once and is logged
Download gives a JSON file of the user's own data
Delete needs the confirm screen, then removes profile, logs and saves; pgTAP checks nothing personal remains

tasks.title: Milestone check M1
ac: npm run verify green in CI
Codex review of auth and RLS changes; findings fixed or rejected with evidence
Board and MEMORY.md updated

tasks.title: Content schema: categories, disciplines, items, steps, links, muscles, workflow, RLS
ac: Three categories: boxing, sc, gym
pgTAP: anonymous users read only published items; a draft read returns nothing
pgTAP: an author cannot set status to published
pgTAP: a reviewer cannot publish an item they wrote
S&C items carry supports tags; gym items carry muscle links
Categories are data, not code: a test adds a fourth category with rows only and the library lists it (decision D5)

tasks.title: Seed sample content for all three categories
ac: Seed is idempotent
Every seeded item has is_sample = true
At least 10 boxing skills, 8 S&C and 10 gym exercises

tasks.title: Library pages: Boxing, S&C, Gym & Fitness with filters
ac: Filters match the mockups for each category
Filters live in the URL, so back and share keep them
End-to-end: filtering boxing drills by equipment shows only matching items
Counts shown are real counts, never fixed numbers
Phone layout matches the reviewed phone board at 390 px (decision D2)

tasks.title: Lesson and exercise pages
ac: YouTube embed through youtube-nocookie, loaded only on tap
Steps, mistakes, safety, prerequisites and practice items from the database
Gym page shows the rep-range table per goal
End-to-end: a draft URL returns 404; a sample item shows Sample, never Coach-verified

tasks.title: Search with Postgres full-text
ac: Searching jab returns the jab skill first and its drills
Results filter by type
Unpublished items never appear

tasks.title: Save and mark complete; Saved page
ac: End-to-end: save and complete a lesson, reload, both persist
Guests are asked to sign in first

tasks.title: Boxing skill path with progress
ac: Path order comes from prerequisite links
Unit: status per skill is done, in progress or not started, from completions

tasks.title: Coach lesson editor and My lessons
ac: Unit: Submit stays disabled until there is a public video, 3 steps, mistakes and safety
Inline errors match the mockup
Status chips: draft, in review, needs changes, live
End-to-end: a coach drafts and submits a lesson
On phones My lessons shows stacked cards, as in M-K-Lessons (decision D3)

tasks.title: Review queue and review page
ac: Approve stays disabled until every check is ticked
Send back needs a note, which the author sees
Own items show the 'another reviewer approves it' message, and the database also blocks it
End-to-end: submit, review, publish, then the lesson is public

tasks.title: Daily check for broken YouTube videos
ac: Unit with a mocked response: a removed or private video sets a broken flag
The author sees the flag in My lessons
Runs once a day

tasks.title: Milestone check M2
ac: The design doc's M2 Verify list passes
Visual check of library and lesson pages against the canvas at 390 and 1440 px
Board and MEMORY.md updated

tasks.title: Program schema: programs, weeks, sessions, typed items, versions, RLS
ac: Prescription types: rounds × work/rest, time, sets × reps × load
Only published library items can be added
pgTAP: only the owning coach edits a program
Publishing creates a new version; enrolled athletes see it from the next day

tasks.title: Program builder
ac: Weeks, sessions, add from library, edit prescription and cue, reorder, publish
End-to-end: a coach builds one boxing and one S&C session and publishes

tasks.title: Invite links: per program, reset, joined list
ac: Link codes are random and unguessable
Joining needs sign-in and a finished 18+ sign-up
After reset the old link shows 'no longer active'
The coach sees each person who joined

tasks.title: Enrollments and the coach access rule
ac: pgTAP: coach A cannot read coach B's athletes
pgTAP: a coach loses access the moment the athlete leaves or is removed
Past feedback stays visible to the athlete
Leave and remove both use confirm screens

tasks.title: Schedule: map program days to dates in Asia/Kolkata
ac: Unit: correct day for joins late at night, across week boundaries and month ends
Several programs merge into one day list

tasks.title: Today: merged sessions, empty state, coach note
ac: End-to-end: an athlete in two programs sees both sessions today
With no program, the empty state offers an invite link and lessons
The latest coach feedback shows with a reply link
Phone layout matches the reviewed phone board at 390 px (decision D2)

tasks.title: Boxing session player: round timer and logging
ac: Unit: timer moves work → rest → next round → done; pause and skip behave
Logs rounds done, technique feel 1–5, effort 1–10 and a note
Screen stays awake while the timer runs where the browser allows
End-to-end: log a full session

tasks.title: Set logger for S&C and gym, with last-time numbers and next target
ac: Each set logs reps × kg; rest timer starts after each set
Shows last time's sets for the same exercise
Unit: if every set hit the top of the rep range, suggest +2.5 kg; otherwise keep the weight
End-to-end: log a gym workout

tasks.title: Session and workout done summaries
ac: Unit: totals equal the saved logs exactly
A note to the coach saves with the session

tasks.title: Metrics: records, adherence, sets per muscle, skill rating
ac: Record rule per metric type is written down and tested with exact values
Adherence = sessions completed ÷ sessions scheduled up to today
Sets per muscle count only hard sets from gym logs
Skill rating = average of the last 5 technique logs

tasks.title: Progress pages (boxing and gym) and body weight log
ac: Every number traces to M3-10 functions
Body weight shows only to the athlete and their current coach
End-to-end: progress numbers equal the logged data

tasks.title: Coach dashboard: adherence board and flags
ac: Unit: flags for reported pain, 3 missed sessions in a row, effort 9+ in the last two sessions
Board shows only the coach's own active athletes
End-to-end: a logged session appears on the board
Phone layout matches the reviewed phone board at 390 px (decision D2)
On phones the adherence board shows stacked cards, as in M-C-CoachDash (decision D3)

tasks.title: Athlete detail, feedback and replies
ac: Coach sees logs and sign-up answers for an enrolled athlete only
End-to-end: coach sends feedback; athlete sees it in Today and Coach feedback and replies; coach sees the reply

tasks.title: Email when a coach leaves feedback
ac: Unit with a mocked sender: one email per note
No email when the athlete turned the setting off

tasks.title: In-app notifications and email preferences
ac: Events: coach feedback, request accepted, session reminder, payment due, new lesson from my coaches
Each event shows in the list; unread items are marked; Mark all as read works
Email per event follows the user's switches; payment receipts always go by email
pgTAP: a user reads only their own notifications

tasks.title: Milestone check M3
ac: The design doc's M3 Verify list passes, plus a gym workout path
Codex review of RLS changes
/qa pass on preview: no high-severity bugs
Board and MEMORY.md updated

tasks.title: Marketplace schema: coach profiles, packages, slots, credentials, RLS
ac: Prices stored as integer paise
Credential files in a private bucket readable only by the coach and admins
pgTAP: a coach edits only their own profile, packages and slots

tasks.title: Coach marketplace profile editor
ac: Headline, philosophy, specialties, languages, formats, city
Packages with price and live switch; client limit; weekly slots
Coach accepts the coach agreement before going live
End-to-end: edits show on the public profile

tasks.title: Credential upload and admin checks
ac: Badge shows 'Credentials checked' only after an admin marks it
Reject needs a note the coach sees
Every decision is logged with the admin and date

tasks.title: Find a coach: discovery, filters and sort
ac: Filters: specialty, format, city, price, rating, experience, credentials, language
Sort never uses payment or paid placement
End-to-end: price filter shows only coaches in range

tasks.title: Public coach profile with computed stats
ac: Stats come from SQL views over engagements and logs; pgTAP compares them to hand-computed values
Packages, slots, portfolio and reviews from the database
Shows 'self-reported' for anything not checked

tasks.title: Shortlist and compare (up to 3)
ac: Shortlist is private to the athlete
Compare shows the same rows as the mockup for up to 3 coaches
End-to-end: shortlist two coaches, then compare

tasks.title: Hire request, accept and decline, client limit
ac: Request saves package, start date, goals and data-sharing consent
Requests pause automatically when the coach hits the client limit
End-to-end: athlete requests; coach accepts; athlete sees Pay
On phones Clients shows stacked cards, as in M-X-CoachRequests (decision D3)

tasks.title: Messages between client and coach
ac: pgTAP: only the two people in a conversation can read it
New messages appear within 10 seconds
Shows the warning about paying outside FitSphere

tasks.title: Checkout and payment webhook
ac: The server sets the amount from the package; the browser cannot change it
Webhook rejects a bad signature
A repeated webhook creates no second engagement (idempotency key)
End-to-end in test mode: pay, and the engagement becomes active

tasks.title: Engagement starts coaching access
ac: An active engagement gives the coach the same access as an enrollment
Access ends when the engagement ends or is refunded
The coach can assign a program to the client

tasks.title: Monthly renewal, cancel and failed payments
ac: Cancel in My programs stops the next renewal and keeps access to the end of the paid month
A failed renewal retries per the provider's rules, then ends the engagement
Athlete and coach get an email for each change
Follows the approved design X-ManageCoaching and X-CancelCoaching

tasks.title: Refunds and payout reversal
ac: Refund follows the owner's written terms
A refund ends the engagement and reverses the coach's share
Every refund is logged

tasks.title: Split payouts and the earnings page
ac: Unit: coach share = price − fee, exact to the paisa, for 3 sample prices
Earnings page totals equal the payments table
pgTAP: a coach sees only their own payouts

tasks.title: Verified reviews and coach replies
ac: pgTAP: only a client with a paid, finished engagement can review, once per engagement
pgTAP: a coach cannot edit or delete a review
A coach can post one public reply
Rating on the profile equals the average of reviews

tasks.title: Client stories with written consent
ac: A story shows only after the client approves the exact text in the app
Body photos need a second, separate consent
The client can withdraw consent and the story disappears

tasks.title: Book a single 1:1 session
ac: Follows the approved design X-Book and X-Booked
A slot can be booked once; a second booking of the same slot fails (database constraint test)
Booking needs payment; cancel follows the refund terms

tasks.title: Reports, suspension and admin report queue
ac: Follows the approved design X-Report, X-ReportSent and R-Reports
Any user can report a review, message or coach
Admin can read only reported messages, hide content and suspend a user; every action is logged

tasks.title: Payments go-live checklist and milestone check M4
ac: All 20 checklist items audited against the code: webhook signatures, failed payments, refunds, upgrades, idempotency, server-side gating, status sync, test clocks, billing page, receipts, event logging, expired cards, tax, trials, duplicate charges, currency, cancel flow, retries, failed-webhook alerts, full test as a customer
The design doc's M4 Verify list passes
Codex final-diff review; findings fixed or rejected with evidence
Live mode only after the owner approves

tasks.title: Retrieval over published, non-sample content
ac: Ranked full-text search returns item ids for citation
pgTAP: draft, in-review and sample items are never returned

tasks.title: Answer service: Claude call, citations, labels, safety
ac: Every answer carries the 'AI explanation' label
Unit: every cited id exists and is published
No-match answers say 'no library source' and contain no sets, reps or loads
Injury questions get a referral and no diagnosis; unsafe requests are refused
Personal data sent: sport, level, goals; health fields only with consent; never name or contact details

tasks.title: Daily question limit and usage log
ac: Unit: the 11th question of the day is blocked with a clear message
Each question logs user, tokens and cost

tasks.title: Ask AI screen with history and actions
ac: Citations link to lessons; 'Add to Today' works
A pain report creates a flag on the coach dashboard
End-to-end: ask, get a cited answer, open the cited lesson
Phone layout matches the reviewed phone board at 390 px (decision D2)

tasks.title: AI eval set and milestone check M5
ac: npm run eval:ai runs at least 30 questions (boxing, S&C, gym, beginner, injury, unsafe, off-topic, no-match) 3 times
100% on code-checked rules in all 3 runs
Judge average at least 90%

tasks.title: Public pages: landing, programs, about, help, for coaches
ac: Match the canvas at 390 and 1440 px
No invented numbers; every count comes from the database
Re-enable the claude-seo plugin (claude plugin enable claude-seo@agricidaniel-claude-seo) and fix every critical finding from /seo audit on public pages

tasks.title: Privacy policy and terms
ac: Uses the owner's signed-off text
Names Anthropic and the payment provider as processors

tasks.title: Empty, loading and error states on every route; 404
ac: A route audit script lists every route and finds no dead button or placeholder
Each data screen has a designed empty state
Coach empty states follow the approved design K-CoachEmpty

tasks.title: Installable PWA
ac: Manifest, icons and an offline fallback page
Installs on Android Chrome and iOS Safari

tasks.title: Speed on low-end Android
ac: Lighthouse mobile performance at least 80 on landing, library and Today
Images served in modern formats at the right size

tasks.title: Accessibility audit
ac: axe finds no serious or critical issue on any route
Keyboard-only path through sign-up, a session and checkout

tasks.title: Security review and rate limits
ac: Rate limits on sign-in, AI and payment routes
/security-review and a Codex review of the full app; findings resolved
No secrets in the repo or client bundle

tasks.title: Final QA and production launch
ac: /qa on the production candidate finds no high-severity bugs
Design doc M6 Verify list passes
Owner approves the production deploy
